Bill.BriefDescription: Providing requirements for business payment contracts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to procedures for written business contracts; andadding a new chapter to Title 19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Authorized business representative" means a natural personauthorized to conduct business on behalf of a business entity,including a limited liability company, corporation, or nonprofitcorporation, registered in Washington or another state. (2) "Business payment contract" means a written agreement betweentwo or more parties in which at least one party is an authorizedbusiness representative who, as consideration for the agreement,promises to personally pay a sum of money to the other party or partiesto the agreement.

Any business payment contract must containthe following for each authorized business representative who is aparty to the agreement: p. 1 HB 1535 (1) A separate signature line, directly following and on the samepage as any other signature line or lines that the authorized businessrepresentative must sign to signal his or her acceptance of theagreement; (2) The signature line must be directly preceded on the same pageby the phrase, "By signing this contract you, the undersigned, agree tobecome PERSONALLY LIABLE for any sums due pursuant to this document,regardless of whether you are signing on behalf of a limited liabilitycompany, corporation, or nonprofit corporation." The phrase must bewritten in bold, fourteenpoint or larger font in clearly visible ink.
It is the duty of any party to the businesspayment contract other than an authorized business representative toensure that the requirements of section 1 of this act are met.

A business payment contract between a partyor parties and an authorized business representative found not to meetthe requirements of section 1 of this act is voidable by the authorizedbusiness representative.
This chapter applies to business paymentcontracts executed on or after January 1, 2012.
Sections 1 through 5 of this act constitutea new chapter in Title 19 RCW.
